question.worked_solution:
From the graph, angle $\alpha $ is an interior angle of a regular octagon.

A regular octagon is an $8$-sided polygon where all the interior angles have the same measure.

The sum of the measures of the interior angles for the $n$-sided polygon equals

$$
{180}^{∘}\times (n-2).
$$

 

Therefore, the sum of the measures of the interior angles of a regular octagon is

$$
{180}^{∘}\times (8-2)=1\,{080}^{∘}.
$$

 

Therefore, the measure of each interior angle is 

$$
\alpha =\frac{1\,{080}^{∘}}{8}={135}^{∘}.
$$
